Definition: to tip over (for the purpose of spilling or pouring out), i.e. (figuratively) depopulate; by implication, to imprison or conquer; (reflexive) to lie down (for coitus)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to stoop, bend, incline; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to stoop, bend; 1a2) to incline, tip; 1b) (Piel) to tip over
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
